text: Kord Campbell 领导 DeepBlue Dynamics，并主导了 ferricula_v2 的重建。
gloss: Kord Campbell leads DeepBlue Dynamics and directed the ferricula v2 rebuild.

text: “法老号”是一艘三桅帆船，于 1815 年抵达马赛。
gloss: The Pharaon is a three-masted ship that arrived at Marseille in 1815.

text: 恢复卷于 2026-07-13 做了快照，并以只读方式挂载。
gloss: The recovery volume was snapshotted on 2026-07-13 and mounted read-only.

text: Steve 实例运行在一个绑定到主机端口 18875 的隔离容器中。
gloss: The Steve instance runs in an isolated container bound to host port 18875.

text: 合并被拒绝，因为矛盾问题返回了 0.8，高于复核阈值。
gloss: The merge was rejected because the contradiction question returned 0.8, above the review threshold.

text: 要撤销一个令牌，先轮换密钥，再挂载新文件重启服务器。
gloss: To revoke a token, rotate the secret, then restart the server with the new file mounted.

text: Alice Nakamura 维护摄取流水线，并评审每一次爬虫变更。
gloss: Alice Nakamura maintains the ingestion pipeline and reviews every crawler change.

text: Ojā 是一段记忆的明亮度或保真度；它会衰减，但文本得以保留。
gloss: Ojā is the brightness or fidelity of a memory; it decays but the text survives.

text: 站会每个工作日九点半举行；二十六日改到了九点四十五。
gloss: Standup happens every weekday at 09:30; on the 26th it moved to 09:45.

text: 审计账本位于工作区根目录下的 audit/2026-09-26 中。
gloss: The audit ledger lives under audit/2026-09-26 in the workspace root.

text: 衰减掌管检索优先级而非删除，因此文本永远不会因熵而丢失。
gloss: Decay governs retrieval priority rather than deletion, so that text is never lost to entropy.

text: 通过在恢复的 logits 上最小化负对数似然来拟合温度，覆盖训练集和开发集。
gloss: Fit the temperature by minimizing negative log-likelihood over the recovered logits on train and dev.

text: Technical Viper 负责运行 parity 基准，并维护独立的证据账本。
gloss: Technical Viper runs the parity benchmarks and keeps the independent evidence ledger.

text: 一个 nimitta 是表示一段记忆的 384 维嵌入向量。
gloss: A nimitta is a 384-dimensional embedding vector representing one memory.

text: 去年三月三日至四月十八日之间记录了四十六个会话。
gloss: Forty-six sessions were recorded between March 3rd and April 18th of last year.

text: 校准文件位于注册表镜像中 Modelfile 的旁边。
gloss: The calibration file sits next to the Modelfile in the registry mirror.

text: 门控放弃作答，因为状态窗口把超过 512 个 token 的簇截断了。
gloss: The gate abstains because the state window truncated the cluster above 512 tokens.

text: 要密封一段记忆，将其所在区块移到 sealed 索引并设置 sealed 标志。
gloss: Seal a memory by moving its section to the sealed index and setting the sealed flag.

text: Bhante Sujato 为 SuttaCentral 将四部尼柯耶译成了英文。
gloss: Bhante Sujato translated the four Nikāyas into English for SuttaCentral.

text: Upekkhā 移除文本但保留 nimitta，因此要点级别的检索仍然可用。
gloss: Upekkhā removes the text but keeps the nimitta so gist-level retrieval still works.

text: 夜间的 bhāvanā 周期凌晨三点开始，四点前结束。
gloss: The nightly bhāvanā cycle starts at 03:00 and finishes before 04:00.

text: 失败索引与成功池分开存储。
gloss: The failures index is stored separately from the success pool.

text: 叠加层被排除在训练之外，因为重建从来不是训练数据。
gloss: Overlays are excluded from training because reconstructions are never training data.

text: 通过直接查询每段锚定记忆并计数命中来衡量锚点召回。
gloss: Measure anchor recall by querying each anchored memory directly and counting hits.

text: Driving Penguin 负责 ferricula-search 和 Lume 集成接口。
gloss: Driving Penguin owns ferricula-search and the Lume integration seam.

text: 自我判断差距是智能体自身结论与证据之间的差异。
gloss: The self-judgment gap is the difference between the agent's own verdict and the evidence.

text: 任期曲线的第六周是在该轮运行第二个周二测得的。
gloss: Week 6 of the tenure curve was measured on the second Tuesday of the run.

text: 基石被钉在检索排序的顶部。
gloss: Keystones are pinned at the top of the retrieval ranking.

text: 简报是临时性的，因此策划出的建议绝不会进入原始存储。
gloss: The briefing is ephemeral so that curated advice never enters the raw store.

text: 将检索集与存储直方图之间的 KL 散度计算为情感偏斜。
gloss: Compute the valence skew as KL divergence between the retrieved set and the store histogram.
